what_is_priced_in.quote: p ratio of 22 is just too high

reasons.claim: A P/E of 22 is too high for this business and he wants a much lower multiple and higher yield before buying.
reasons.quote: p ratio of 22 is just too high call me when it gets to 15 on perhaps even lower earnings and a dividend yield of four five%

data_check.gap_note: he says 22, as-of 16.4713 (FY2023); annual vs TTM or a different definition; not in our data: target pe ratio, target dividend yield

reasons.claim: Margins are still above normal after a pandemic-driven boom, so a two-year normalization could push earnings and the stock down materially.
reasons.quote: there was this boom Global expansion growth this and that and pandemic home and buying more of that and now maybe we are just looking for a two-year return to normality for margins

reasons.claim: Guidance has been lowered to 6% growth but recent revenue is actually declining, making the target hard to reach.
reasons.quote: they have lowered their guidance to down mid single digits down is not 6% growth and if you go down let's say 5% you need a lot of work to catch up to the 6% growth

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: long-term eps growth target

reasons.claim: The Q2 collapse in sales and EPS shows the classic Delta-of-the-Delta double whammy of falling earnings and contracting multiple.
reasons.quote: perhaps the biggest shock was Q2 when sales decreased 16% and adjusted earnings per share decreased 36% which was insane

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.16, as-of 0.071569 (FY2023); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: The prior run-up in the stock was a sign of exuberance and it may still be above its long-term trend, and the current yield does not compensate for the risk.
reasons.quote: 3.6% yield is not enough for taking the risks that have been disclosed

external_facts_used: Talk of a Mondelez takeover of Hershey
Hershey charitable trust's uncertainty about what to do with its stake
Company's long-term guidance of net sales and adjusted EPS growth lowered to 6%
Company presentation showing 4% chocolate segment growth per year target and expansion into Emerging Markets
